posts.title: Book Notes: The Nvidia Way
posts.description: Book: The Nvidia Way Author: Tae Kim Summary An old style valley hagiography. The hero, after trials and tribulations, emerges stronger and wiser than before, and is given his due. I enjoyed every page of it. Interestingly, not a word about cryptocurrency. That was a whole wave of demand. Among Nvidia's talents is the ability to ride any and every wave it can find and sell those damn gpus. Notes H

posts.title: Unlearning
posts.description: MORE AND LESS Each day of studying the world leads you to more . Each day of harmonizing with Dao inclines you to less . Less, still less, until you do nothing. Do nothing so that nothing is undone. To take the world lastingly requires a mind empty of deeds. A mind yearning for deeds, on the other hand, can never take the world. -- Laozi's Dao De Jing, Chapter 48, translated by Ken Liu "Therefore
